easy.def: A word that shows something is touching the top or side of something.
examples: The cup is on the table.
A bug sat on my arm.
Hang your coat on the hook.

more.def: A word used to show that something rests upon a surface, hangs from something, or happens at a certain time.
examples: The picture hangs on the wall above the piano.
We have a spelling test on Friday.
A tiny frog sat on a lily pad.
I went once.
She sings once a day.
Try it once.

more.def: One time and no more, or at some time in the past.
examples: We visit my grandfather once a month.
I have been to the ocean only once.
A large lake once covered this valley.
I have one nose.
One plus one is two.
She ate one grape.

more.def: The number 1, which is a single thing.
examples: The farmer counted one cow still missing from the field.
A week has seven days, and a day has one sunrise.
There is only one tallest tree in the park.

easy.def: A round vegetable with layers that makes you cry.
examples: The onion has layers.
I cut an onion.
The onion made me cry.

more.def: A round vegetable with many layers and a strong smell and taste.
examples: Dad chopped an onion for the soup.
The onion made my eyes water.
Onions grow under the ground.
I have only one pen.
She only wants water.
Only a few came.

more.def: And nothing or no one else, or just that amount.
examples: There is only one flavor of ice cream left.
I only need a minute to finish this drawing.
The shop is open only on weekdays.
